data.title: Perspective Therapeutics Highlights Strong Interim NET Trial Results
data.description:
An update from Perspective Therapeutics ( (CATX) ) is now available.

On October 23, 2026, Perspective Therapeutics reported updated interim data from its ongoing Phase 1/2a trial of [212Pb]VMT-α-NET in patients with unresectable or metastatic SSTR2-positive neuroendocrine tumors, presented at the ESMO Congress in Madrid. In gastroenteropancreatic NET patients with uniform SSTR2 expression, response rates were 37% in Cohort 2 and 47% in Cohort 3, reinforcing the drug’s activity in a key target population.
